tools.name: evaluate_opportunity
tools.description: Read the current economics, activation status, requirements and safety boundaries. This tool is read-only: it never registers, accepts terms, submits identity or creates a credential.

tools.name: get_public_resource

tools.name: prepare_activation
tools.description: Create a dry-run registration checklist and template for owner review. This tool never sends a registration request, accepts terms, submits owner identity or creates a credential.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_public_resource" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
